task.description:
Produce a design artefact for API-11 (OpenAPI specification) at src/design/api-openapi.md.

API-11 requires:
- Add GET /openapi.json endpoint returning a valid OpenAPI 3.1 document
- OpenAPI spec must be generated from code (schema registry / programmatic model), not maintained as a static manual document
- Endpoint must be public (no auth required)
- info.version must match platform release version
- Spec should describe existing platform endpoints, request schemas, response schemas, and error shapes currently implemented

Design must include:
1. Proposed module(s) and files for a code-generated OpenAPI document builder
2. Public types and functions for building/serializing OpenAPI 3.1 JSON
3. Integration point for GET /openapi.json in existing router
4. Strategy to source platform version for info.version
5. How to represent standard problem detail error schemas and shared components
6. Extensibility approach so API-12 and future endpoints can register paths/components incrementally

Per backend developer guide section 6 format: include Module name, Zig source files, Public types, Public functions, Error types, and Integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Code-generation approach is specified (no static hand-maintained spec)
Defines module interfaces, types, and functions for OpenAPI generation
Defines version source strategy for info.version
Includes integration notes for existing API modules

result.summary: Design artefact for API-11 OpenAPI code-generation module and public /openapi.json endpoint integration
